_title: MolDX: Prostate Cancer Genomic Classifier Assay for Men with Localized Disease

criteria.text: Test intended to identify localized prostate cancer patients with >=10yr life expectancy who are good active-surveillance candidates per NCCN guidelines
criteria.source_span: The test is considered reasonable and necessary to help identify men with localized Prostate Cancer and a life expectancy of at least 10 years who are good candidates for active surveillance according to the most recent National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) guidelines.

criteria.text: Decipher covered for men with localized/biochemically recurrent prostate adenocarcinoma (no metastasis) with life expectancy >=10 years who are candidates for one of the listed treatment-transition scenarios
criteria.source_span: With localized or biochemically recurrent adenocarcinoma of the prostate (i.e. no clinical evidence of metastasis) who have a life expectancy of greater than or equal to 10 years if they are a candidate for and are considering (or being considered for) at least one of the following:

criteria.text: Patient is a candidate for/considering at least one of the listed treatment-transition scenarios
sub_conditions: Conservative management and yet would be eligible for definitive therapy (radical prostatectomy (RP), radiation or brachytherapy)
Radiation therapy and yet would be eligible for the addition of a brachytherapy boost
Radiation therapy and yet would be eligible for the addition of short-term androgen deprivation therapy(ADT)
Radiation therapy with short-term ADT yet would be eligible for the use of long term ADT
Radiation with standard ADT yet would be eligible for systemic therapy intensification using next generation androgen signaling inhibitors or chemotherapy
Observation post-prostatectomy yet would be eligible for the addition of post-operative adjuvant radiotherapy
Salvage radiotherapy post-prostatectomy yet would be eligible for the addition of ADT.
criteria.source_span: if they are a candidate for and are considering (or being considered for) at least one of the following:

criteria.text: All of the following additional criteria must also be met for coverage
sub_conditions: The assay is performed on formalin-fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) prostate biopsy tissue with at least 0.5 mm of linear tumor diameter or FFPE tissue from a prostate resection specimen
Result will be used to determine treatment according to established practice guidelines
Patient has not received pelvic radiation or ADT prior to the biopsy or prostate resection specimen
Patient is monitored for disease progression according to established standard of care
criteria.source_span: The following criteria must also be met for coverage:

criteria.text: Other genomic tests with equivalent analytical/clinical validity are also reasonable and necessary for the same indications, subject to MolDX technical assessment
criteria.source_span: Other genomic tests that demonstrate an equivalent analytical validity and clinical validity will be considered reasonable and necessary for the same indications.
